requirement.original: Four sidebar polish requirements: R2 (agent sidebar full conversation), R3 (sub-tool clicks stay in sidebar), R4 (bash inline abbreviated content + sidebar), R5 (todo sidebar + checkbox icons)
requirement.clarified: Polish the right sidebar with full agent conversations, sidebar-internal navigation for sub-tools, abbreviated bash output inline, and todo sidebar with Ionicon checkboxes
requirement.what: Four UI improvements to the right sidebar and inline tool card rendering
requirement.why: Improve user experience when inspecting tool details - avoid disruptive navigation, show more context inline, use consistent iconography

included: R2: Show orchestrator prompt + all child message types in agent sidebar
R3: Sub-tool clicks replace sidebar content instead of navigating main area
R4: Show abbreviated bash output inline, full terminal in sidebar on click
R5: Todo content click opens sidebar, replace text checkboxes with Ionicons
excluded: Adding new sidebar renderers for file tools (already exist)

success_criteria: Agent sidebar shows tool.input.prompt at top and renders all child message kinds
Clicking sub-tool header in sidebar replaces sidebar content (main area unchanged)
Back button in sidebar returns to parent agent conversation
Bash inline content area shows first 3-5 lines of terminal output
Clicking bash content area opens sidebar with full CommandView terminal
Todo content click opens sidebar with full todo list
Todo checkboxes use Ionicons: checkmark-circle (green/completed), time-outline (blue/in-progress), ellipse-outline (gray/pending)
constraints: Never use router.push() from sidebar components
Must work on desktop (side panel) and mobile (modal) sidebar modes
All new user-facing strings must use t() i18n function
Follow existing component patterns (memo, StyleSheet.create with theme)

root_cause_analysis.symptom: N/A - feature enhancement, not bug fix

research_findings.reason: Straightforward UI modifications following existing codebase patterns. No novel architecture or design decisions needed.

context.codebase_state: Main branch, sidebar system already functional with Zustand store
context.recent_commits: Recent commits include sidebar and tool view work

SidebarAgentConversation.tsx.current_behavior: Renders agent-text and tool-call children only. Shows result at bottom. Does NOT show orchestrator prompt. Switch default returns null for agent-event, user-text.

data_available.tool.input.prompt: Contains the orchestrator prompt text sent to the sub-agent
data_available.tool.input.description: Used for the title in ToolView header, separate from prompt
data_available.tool.result: String result shown at bottom when completed
data_available.messages: Message[] = children of the Agent/Task tool call, contains agent-text, tool-call, agent-event types

SidebarAgentConversation.tsx.child_ToolView_navigation: ToolView receives sessionId and messageId, so handlePress calls router.push() navigating main content area away

routing.fallthrough: SidebarGenericView for everything else including TodoWrite

rightSidebarStore.ts.note: No navigation stack - single flat state. R3 requires adding history/stack.

ToolView.tsx.content_press: Calls onContentPress callback which opens sidebar via Zustand store
ToolView.tsx.content_pressable: Only when onContentPress is provided AND tool has specialized view AND not minimal

BashView.tsx.current_inline: Shows CommandView with command only (stdout=null, stderr=null). No output shown inline.
BashView.tsx.sidebar: SidebarBashView already renders full terminal with stdout/stderr in sidebar
BashView.tsx.detail_page: BashViewFull renders full terminal with horizontal scroll

TodoView.tsx.current_styles: Green+strikethrough for completed, blue for in-progress, gray for pending
TodoView.tsx.no_sidebar: TodoWrite not in SidebarContentRenderer routing, falls to SidebarGenericView

TaskView.tsx.ToolStatusIcon: Uses Ionicons: checkmark-circle (green) for completed, ActivityIndicator for running, close-circle for error
TaskView.tsx.reference_for_R5: The green checkmark-circle icon at line 130 is the target icon for todo completed items

development_approach.strategy: Implement four independent improvements in order R5 (simplest) -> R4 -> R2 -> R3 (most complex)

changes: Replace text checkbox characters with Ionicons components
Add View wrapper for icon + text in row layout
Add TODO_TOOLS = new Set(['TodoWrite']) routing to SidebarTodoView
Parse tool.result to extract stdout/stderr (same pattern as BashViewFull)
Show first 3-5 lines of stdout in CommandView instead of null
Add maxHeight to limit inline display
Add orchestrator prompt section at top (from tool.input.prompt or tool.input.description)
Handle agent-event message kind in ChildMessageBlock switch
Pass custom onPress to child ToolView to prevent router navigation
When sub-tool clicked, call sidebar open with sub-tool data
Add history: SidebarData[] array for navigation stack
Add pushView(data) action that saves current to history and sets new
Add popView() action that restores previous from history
Add back button to SidebarHeader when history.length > 0

development_approach.validation_approach: Playwright E2E on dev.life-ai.app: open session with Agent tool calls, verify sidebar shows prompt, click sub-tool stays in sidebar, bash shows abbreviated output, todo shows correct icons
